d: Royal Apartments. Spanish Knights Choir entering on one side hastily; on the other side Rodrigo enters.
Caritea goes out with Don Fernando and some Damigelle.

Camping of D. Alfonso in the vicinity of the Tagus. Far away you can see the city of Toledo. The main tent of D. Alfonso, which is on the one hand, will be workable and grandiose internally. Diego in armor with a Shield.
Corrado leaves the tent of D. Alfonso, and said.
The great tent of D. Alfonso opens. At the sound of the warlike instruments the entire army moves in the act that arose d. Alfonso preceded by a choir of Warriors.
Diego and sayings.
Rodrigo and D. Alfonso.

Wide country on the hills on the banks of the Tagus. Superior there will be a large stone bridge practicable, below a wooden construct. You will see some tents of the soldiers of D. Diego. Diego, then Rodrigo.
A body of Guastatori comes to tear down the wooden bridge; the Portuguese army, meanwhile, derails for the upper stone bridge, having at their head the same d. Alfonso.
Caritea in manly armor with a soldier's drape appears on the left side of the wooden bridge, which is half ruined.
Diego comes out to Caritea's cry, seeing her in danger, she screams with some of hers into a mess and goes under the bridge to help her.
The Portuguese Army revisits the stone bridge. The choir of Guastatori sings the following song, behind them you can see D. Alfonso, Corrado and some Spanish Prisoners, among them D. Fernando.
D. Aldonso following his soldiers, and a few Spanish prisoners, including Fr. Fernando.
Chorus of Warriors of D. Alfonso who descend hastily.
Royal apartments like scene I, act I.D. Fernando solo, indi Diego, then Rodrigo.
Caritea with Damigelle, and sayings.
Usually camp with the tent of D. Alfonso. Chorus of warriors of D. Alfonso who are observing in the interior of the tent, in the fate of D. Alfonso.
Royal apartments. Diego indi Caritea.
Choir of Spanish Knights, and sayings.
Remote place in the royal gardens, on the one hand you will see a monument erected to the young Pompey. Caritea with Damigelle.
Choir of Spanish warriors, and sayings.
Exterior of the city of Toledo. Don Alfonso will be outside the city with a body of his Warriors, then Diego will come out of the city gate together with a body of his own.
Only royal apartments. Don Fernando solo, then Rodrigo.

Grand square of Toledo. Chorus of Spanish Warriors with People, Indi Caritea with his Damigelle. Don Fernando, Rodrigo and follow-up of Warriors, on the one hand, on the other Diego with the follow-up of his Soldiers, who comes in triumph.
